overview.routesDescription: Growth is implemented only where backend admin coverage is real. Each route below maps to an existing operator-safe surface.

routes.campaigns: Create draft campaigns, edit versioned metadata, and request audited lifecycle transitions.
routes.promoCodes: Create, inspect, update, and deactivate campaign promo codes.
routes.inviteCodes: Generate invite batches for a specific user with optional plan targeting.
routes.giftCodes: Issue single or batch customer gift codes, inspect live inventory, and track redemption posture.
routes.partners: Promote users, review the live partner directory, and jump into customer operations.
routes.reporting: Review persisted rollups, reporting subscriptions, governance coverage, and exportable delivery artifacts.
routes.notifications: Send operator-authored growth notices and inspect per-channel delivery forensics.
routes.rules: Build and simulate typed growth rule ASTs through the backend compiler.
routes.siteMode: Preview cabinet-only routing from the real client capability response and track missing admin rollback APIs.
routes.fx: Review FX readiness from generated capabilities and run backend-authoritative conversion simulations.
routes.privateAccess: Inspect private-access readiness, open grants, and revoke grants through generated admin endpoints.
routes.onboarding: Review post-registration onboarding capabilities, update runtime settings, and reset states through audited admin APIs.
routes.risk: Triage growth risk model lifecycle, decisions, and manual review resolution from generated admin endpoints.
routes.referrals: Monitor referral commissions, top referrers, and recent conversion-linked earnings.
